notes.title: Reminder: Zeno Clash figurine giveaway! [3 days left!]
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/552434/b60635d9a354c60539cb0f33e9d8999f408e057e.jpg[/img]

Hello, Zeno Clash fans.

Steam has just released a new feature so now we have our very own [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/aceteam/]ACE Team developer page[/url][/b] directly on Steam! By following this group you will be more connected with our existing and future projects, so it’s a great new feature if you’re looking forward to more updates from us. 

[h1]To celebrate this event we’re running a cool giveaway where you can win an awesome 3D printed [b]Golem figurine[/b]. All that you have to do to participate in the draw is to [u][b]follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/aceteam/]developer page[/url][/b][/u] and [u][b]leave a comment[/b][/u] under this announcement.[/h1]

Winners will be chosen on [b]August 1st[/b] and announced through this channel.

Good luck to all the participants! [b]Note that there are several other figurines from our other titles in the draw.[/b]

We will be picking winners from the collected pool of comments from all announcements. We can't choose from a specific announcement because there are more of them than there are figurines. Don't worry about someone commenting under multiple announcements, I will make a list of all participants and make sure that everyone listed once.

[h1]No need to comment again, if you already did before.[/h1]

notes.title: Rock of Ages figurine and Zeno Clash keys giveaway!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

We're running a new Rock of Ages themed giveaway. This time we'll draw a cool [b]3D print[/b] of the game's lovely boulder lead! Ideal for your videogame collection.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233280/082a93850598e420c0bf86db376847bdd0650a95.jpg[/img]

To participate all you have to do is be a member of the [b]Rock of Ages 2 hub[/b]. In addition, if you wishlist the game on Steam your chances of winning are [b]twice as good[/b]!!

To join the hub press "Follow" on the Rock of Ages 2 Steam store page:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/434460/Rock_of_Ages_2_Bigger__Boulder/

We're also running this contest on some of our other social media sites. Join our Facebook and Twitter pages and share our posts about this giveaway if you want to increase your odds:

[b]Facebook:[/b]
https://www.facebook.com/theACETeam/

[b]Twitter:[/b]
https://twitter.com/theACETeam

We'll be drawing 3 figurines in the RoA2 hub. Winners will be announced on [b]Friday June the 9th[/b]. Good luck to everyone! Don't forget to tell your friends!

[h1][b]And as something exclusively for you guys, [u]members of the Zeno Clash hub[/u], we are giving away [u]5 Steam keys for Zeno Clash[/u]. I know, most of you already own it, but you could give it to a friend. [u]To enter, simply leave any comment under this announcement.[/u] Keys winners will also be announced on Friday June the 9th.[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Fan made Zeno Clash multiplayer mod (alpha version) released!
notes.content:
[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/tschumann]tschumann's[/url] passion and dedication for Zeno Clash has resulted in a long awaited multiplayer mod![/h1]

[i][url=http://forums.aceteam.cl/index.php?showtopic=5066]"It's still a work in progress - you can't respawn, melee weapons don't do damage and you can't choose your player model but all players can enter combat mode."[/url][/i]

[b]Download it here: http://www.moddb.com/mods/zeno-clash-multiplayer/downloads/zeno-clash-multiplayer-alpha-1[/b]

Thank you, tschumann for this awesome creation. I hope many people are going to enjoy it! :zcskullbomb:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/552434/3fcb9bc503fac2c3037f28ec41231b6d197e1737.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Zeno Clash Update #3 released!
notes.content:
Here are the new features & fixes:

-Added damage counter and timer for challenge mode. Damage counter warns player 20 HP before losing to personal record. Timer warns player 20 sec before losing to personal record
-Animal cruelty achievement fixed. Works as global counter
-Added Italian language and translation credits to the game
-Fixed crash when switching shadow quality in-game
-Player auto-locks on to F-M when health drops to zero (Single-Player)
-Tower Challenge F-M does not require lock-on to defeat
-Fixed throwing your weapon in maps where it causes problems
-Player returns to Challenge screen when dying in a tower level
-Fixed timer bug when pausing a Tower Challenge
-Tweaked collision detection for uppercut finisher and deflect kick
-Player now does attack sound when throwing weapons
-Moved health fruit in final map so it is easier to pick up

notes.title: Zeno Clash Update #2 released!
notes.content:
Here are the new features / fixes:

- New feature: The player can throw the weapon with the 'block' key
- Added a manual lock-on option in the main menu
- Fixed grab items / autolock conflict (enemies can't be targeted when looking down)
- Player can now unlock by running backwards
- Balanced difficulty level of Tower challenges
- Final boss battle has a health fruit (slightly easier)
- Boss characters can grab the player when he is unlocked
- Fixed infinite kick exploit
- Fixed heavy opponents pains issue
